title: Huh? (Cat)
blurb: The Huh? cat sound — a bewildered little noise that perfectly captures the moment comprehension fails. Attached to the famous confused-cat meme, it's the audio equivalent of a head tilt. Use it when someone says something that makes no sense, when instructions are unclear, or when you check your bank account. Small sound, enormous relatability.
origin: Paired with the viral confused cat meme; the sound of pure bafflement.
